rules.statement: A lessor cannot sue his lessee for ejectment under the Rent Restriction Act for being in default of rent unless he can first establish the termination of the contract of lease either by due notice or by effluxion of time.
rules.supporting_quote: But this does not relieve the landlord of establishing the termination of the contract (either by due notice or by effluxion of time) before claiming a decree for ejectment.

meta.parties: Chettinad Corporation Ltd. v. Zaneek, A.M.M
